sentences.text: Johnny Mnemonic is a 1995 Canadian-American cyberpunk action thriller film directed by Robert Longo in his directorial debut .	Robert Longo	Robert Longo	Johnny Mnemonic	Johnny Mnemonic	cyberpunk	cyberpunk	action	action film	thriller film	thriller film
The film stars Keanu Reeves and Dolph Lundgren .	Keanu Reeves	Keanu Reeves	Dolph Lundgren	Dolph Lundgren
The film is based on the story of the same name by William Gibson .	William Gibson	William Gibson	same name	Johnny Mnemonic
Keanu Reeves plays the title character , a man with a cybernetic brain implant designed to store information .	Keanu Reeves	Keanu Reeves	cybernetic	cybernetic	brain implant	brain implant
The film portrays Gibson 's dystopian view of the future with the world dominated by megacorporations and with strong East Asian influences .	dystopian	dystopian
This was Dolph Lundgren 's last theatrically released film until 2010 's The Expendables .	Dolph Lundgren	Dolph Lundgren	The Expendables	The Expendables (2010 film)

The film was shot on location in Canada , with Toronto and Montreal filling in for the film 's Newark and Beijing settings .	Toronto	Toronto	Montreal	Montreal	Newark	Newark, New Jersey	Beijing	Beijing

A number of local sites , including Toronto 's Union Station and Montreal 's skyline and Jacques Cartier Bridge , feature prominently .	Toronto	Toronto	Montreal	Montreal	Union Station	Union Station (Toronto)	Jacques Cartier Bridge	Jacques Cartier Bridge

The film premiered in Japan on April 15 , 1995 , in a longer version -LRB- 103 mins -RRB- that is closer to the director 's cut , featuring a score by Mychael Danna and different editing .	Mychael Danna	Mychael Danna
The film was released in the United States on May 26 , 1995 .
